ORAL ORDER 2 10-07-2024 Present learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 as well as learned A.P.P. for the State.
02. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the present case has been filed by the opposite party no.2 who is the wife of the petitioner under Section 498A and other allied sections of IPC.

Learned counsel further submits that both the parties are ready to explore the possibility of settlement, for which they submit that the matter may be referred to the Patna High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre.

opennyai_summary.decision:
03. Having considered the aforesaid submission, the matter is referred to the Patna High Court Mediation and Patna High Court CR.
